question: The autobiography of famous yoga guru Swami Ramdev is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**My Life, My Mission.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **"My Life, My Mission"** is an autobiography of yoga guru **Swami Ramdev**, who wrote this book with senior journalist** Uday Mahurkar.**
 
• The book describes the life of Swami Ramdev from a village in Haryana to the international level.
 
• This book is published by Penguin Random House.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Swami Ramdev-**

 
 
• **Swami Ramdev is a yoga teacher, he is also the co-founder of Patanjali Ayurved Limited.**
 
• He was born on 25 December 1965 in Mahendragarh, Haryana.
 
• He did his early studies at Kalwa Gurukul.
 
• He founded the Divya Yoga Mandir Trust in 1995.
 
• Later in 2003, his yoga program started airing on the Aastha TV channel.
